status: 52-head force-and-two-first-moment comparison; gravity budgets and signed wind/uplift are not soil reactions under verified stiffness or accepted junction capacities
adverseMethod: Per origin and every quadrature station take positive and negative influence separately: G=0..1.35, Q=0..1.5, roof independent row pressures=-2.25..+6.3 kPa, structural metal=0..1.35G. Combine with both axis winds independently at full envelope (including diagonals). Each head lists independentAdverseNCxCy as [min,max] in N, Cx, Cy order; bounds are not simultaneous and MUST NOT be summed. Zero favourable dead load is credited.
interpretation: Units kN,kNm,mm. G/Q/U each conserved in every named origin family. Positive compression; U is -2.25kPa roof with no favourable G. Eccentric Cx=N*deltaX, Cy=N*deltaY. Each head gives [N,Cx,Cy], not an unsigned resultant. U+direction and 1.35G+1.5Q+direction are separate conservative envelopes, not a prescribed code combination. Each span treated as end-supported, signed cantilever reactions allowed: stiffness, alternate load patterns, positive ties and shaft moment resistance are not credited. Gross filled wall openings are a one-sided maximum; never stabilise adverse uplift with fictitious masonry.

lateral.groupCondition: Rigid symmetric restrained diaphragms; signs transformed by each mirrored L. Vertical group couple conserved about head at -750; no pile bending credited for that couple. Whole group lateral shear separately assigned as adverse per-head demand; do not sum per-head adverse group shares. Foundation stiffness, settlement and soil capacity unknown.
